named_question: Which selected stored mood options have recovered defaults and checkbox projections without inferring native permissions or graph state?

static_byte_pins.purpose: Anonymous binder label is NUL-terminated Move.
Default zero initialization covers Move+0x88, SkipNext+0x8c, Sequencing+0x90, ReadOnly+0x94, MixMod+0x98 and CID+0xa8.
SkipNext column4 checkbox receives SkipNext==0, not the raw flag.
Shared boolean conversion compares cleared/read string with TRUE.

reused_contracts.fact: Column5 is not a checkbox above SID31 and CID12..19 displayed/disabled state depends on current owner/role state.
Omitted CID has reader default0; unsupported explicit identity is not defaulted by the CLI.
SName is a separate optional string; absent/empty reads as empty, not inherited text. Editing normalization is not applied on inspection.

CLI_policy.command: lox config lighting inspect-mood-options FILE BLOCK --mood SID_OR_NAME [--room ROOM]
CLI_policy.selection: Reuse exact direct metadata selection: LightController2, one direct collection and one unambiguous exact stored SID spelling or case-sensitive Name. Nested decoys and numeric Name/SID collisions do not silently select a record.
CLI_policy.flags: SkipNext, MixMod, ReadOnly, Sequencing and Move report raw stored spelling, effective value and recovered default false. Explicit interpretation is conservatively limited to canonical true/false; other spellings remain raw/unresolved with diagnostics. Missing remains raw null, not inserted false.
CLI_policy.cycling: For a resolved stored SkipNext, report inverse checkbox projection. It is not a prediction that a stored row is imported, displayed or editable.
CLI_policy.mix: For SID1..31 and supported nonnegative CID outside12..19, report direct model-boolean projection. Omitted CID uses recovered0. CID12..19 remains role_dependent with checked null, not the stored flag or a guessed role mask. SID>31 is not_checkbox_row. Unsupported needed SID/CID is unresolved_identity. Unsupported explicit MixMod is unresolved_value where a direct projection would otherwise apply.
CLI_policy.stored_only: Move, ReadOnly and Sequencing have no new UI-action, order, sequence or permission interpretation. Never turn ReadOnly into a complete GUI access model.
CLI_policy.display_name: Report SName stored/effective/default independently of Name. Preserve arbitrary stored text without uppercase conversion or sanitization; omission has effective/default empty string.
CLI_policy.formats: Complete JSON with diagnostics; table and CSV include all five flags plus SName. CSV explicitly includes STORED_PRESENT to distinguish missing from explicit empty text. Projection/operation limitations remain visible on stderr with quiet/no-header.
CLI_policy.preservation: Read-only; no file save, stamp change, default insertion, normalization, ID/output/reference/sequence/HCL edits.
CLI_policy.limits: Stored model projections only. Not current graph state, Num-limited import, row visibility, uniqueness/write admission, GUI permissions, accepted-dialog or runtime parity. Every edit operation still independently validates its target.
